output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount parameters are both of type uint256, allowing them to be manipulated to overflow and set the totalSupply to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to the owner.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is of type uint256, allowing it to be manipulated to overflow and set the balanceOf of a target to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to the recipient.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is of type uint256, allowing it to be manipulated to overflow and set the balanceOf of a target to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to the recipient.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is of type uint256, allowing it to be manipulated to overflow and set the allowance of a spender to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to the spender.

The approveAndCall function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is of type uint256, allowing it to be manipulated to overflow and set the allowance of a spender to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to the spender.
